highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with HarfBuzz 14.4.0.
highlights_body: The bundled shaping engine changes cross-direction mark positioning and improves malformed-font handling. RAW/DNG decoding is retired; Ganesh failed-flush cleanup and Linux font-family matching are corrected.

breaking.title: Built-in RAW and DNG decoding removed
breaking.body: RAW/DNG development and extraction of embedded JPEG previews are no longer supported. Use a separate RAW decoder or convert files before loading them. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains its value of 10 for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz mark positioning can change
breaking.body: HarfBuzz 14.4 intentionally changes cross-direction mark positioning for DirectWrite and Core Text compatibility. Review text layouts and rendering baselines that depend on the previous shaping output.

bullets.detail: Advances the renderer while preserving rotation-scale text-run bounds and the existing managed and C API surface.
Includes glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping and subsetting performance work.
Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enum values. Raw OpenType fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced.

bullets.lead: Failed-flush cache cleanup and Linux font ranking
bullets.detail: Clears uniquely held cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush. Fontconfig checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate instead of accepting a lower-ranked substitute.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 updated HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: The release candidate corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and Linux fontconfig first-candidate matching.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the native shaping engine to HarfBuzz 14.4.0, including cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and performance work. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums without public raw-fetch wrappers.
